name: Mukhyamantri Vriksharopan Protsahan Yojana
benefit:
Those farmers who have taken paddy crop in Kharif year 2020 and sold paddy to the government, if they plant trees in their fields instead of paddy crop, will get Rs. 10,000/- per year for the next 3 years in case of successful plantation. The incentive amount will be given at the rate of (ten thousand) per acre.
The forest/revenue forest land on which the forest rights letter has been given, also
_eligibility_text:
1. All the farmers of Chhattisgarh state who have sold paddy to the government after cultivating paddy in the year 2020.
1. Those forest rights holders who had sold paddy to the government last year now want to plant trees instead of paddy on their land.
1. Forest rights holders who want to plant trees on their land afresh.
1.  All Gram Panchayats and Joint Forest Management Committees who want to plant trees in revenue land with the amount available with them.
